PCGen's own row format also carries no fractional-value token for this family. Decision for this shape (applies to the sibling DAMAGEMULT units this lane did not reach live-test time for): the comparable magnitude WOULD be the fractional DAMAGEMULT value itself if a token existed; none does, so unverifiable rather than a fabricated integer truncation (truncating -0.5 to 0 or -1 would manufacture a false agree/disagree).
